title: Loading /dashboard renders all 6 populated board cards for an org with real data
description: AuditOverviewContent.jsx renders a SimpleGrid of 6 MetricCards (Resource, Compliance, Framework, Audit, Vendor, Risk Board) fed from a single dashboardService.getDashboardMetrics() call plus 5 parallel trend calls.
preconditions: Logged in as an org member
Org has at least one active project with compliance/risk/vendor/audit data
steps: Wait for the 6 BoardCardSkeleton placeholders to disappear
expectedResult: All 6 cards (Resource, Compliance, Framework, Audit, Vendor, Risk Board) render with non-zero, populated KPI values, sparklines/donuts/gauges, and the 'LIVE DATA' pulse indicator, within a few seconds of navigation.

title: Clicking a board card collapses the grid into the NavCard strip and expands that board's detail content
description: handleCardClick collapses the 6-card SimpleGrid into a horizontal NavCard strip and mounts the matching *BoardContent component below (e.g. ComplianceBoardContent for the Compliance Board). This is the dashboard's only in-page 'quick action' style navigation.
steps: Observe the grid collapse into the NavCard strip with 'Compliance Board' active
expectedResult: ComplianceBoardContent renders below the NavCard strip with a breadcrumb 'Overview / Compliance Board'; clicking 'Overview' restores the original 6-card idle grid.

title: Deselecting every project in the filter bar zeroes out all 6 cards instead of leaving stale numbers on screen
description: When selectedProjectIds becomes empty, AuditOverviewContent sets metrics=null and skips the fetch entirely; every card falls back to its hardcoded default (e.g. '0%', '0') via optional-chaining fallbacks.
steps: On /dashboard with data populated, open the Filters project picker
expectedResult: All 6 cards immediately show their zero/default values (0%, 0) rather than continuing to display the previously-fetched org-wide numbers; no network call to /api/dashboard/metrics fires while zero projects are selected.

title: Selecting a date preset re-fetches metrics and updates Finding/risk-derived numbers only
description: DashboardFilterBar's date preset drives dateFrom/dateTo in effectiveFilters, which only affects the Finding and risks aggregations server-side (per dashboard-metrics/index.js's dateRangeMatch) — compliance's snapshot-based timeline is unaffected.
steps: On /dashboard, open Filters and select 'Last 7 Days'
Observe the Resource and Risk Board cards update
Observe the Compliance Board card's KPI value
expectedResult: A new /api/dashboard/metrics request fires with dateFrom/dateTo set to the last 7 days; Resource/Risk numbers reflect only recent findings/risks; the Compliance Board's coverage % is unchanged by the date filter.

title: A brand-new org with zero projects/risks/vendors/frameworks loads the dashboard without errors
description: Verifies the honest-empty-state design principle documented throughout dashboard-metrics/index.js and AuditOverviewContent.jsx: absent data must render as '0', '—', or a 'Pending' badge, never a fabricated non-zero number.
preconditions: Newly onboarded org with no projects created yet, or one empty project and no evidence/risk/vendor/audit data
steps: Log in as the new org's first user and navigate to /dashboard
expectedResult: The page loads without a console error or the red error Alert; all 6 cards render with 0%/0 KPI values, empty donuts/gauges, and Vendor/Resource Board's 'pending' metric rows show their dashed badge rather than 0.

title: Switching the Sidebar's active project re-syncs the dashboard's own project filter
description: AuditOverviewContent watches the Redux sidebarSelectedProject and re-seeds selectedProjectIds to just that project whenever it changes, unless the user has already manually broadened the dashboard's own Filters selection.
preconditions: User belongs to at least 2 projects
steps: On /dashboard, note the current KPI values (scoped to Project A via the Sidebar)
Use the Sidebar's project selector to switch to Project B
expectedResult: The dashboard's Filters project picker updates to show only Project B selected, and all 6 cards refresh to Project B's numbers.

title: The 6-card grid collapses to a single column on a mobile viewport with the filter bar still usable
description: The SimpleGrid uses columns={{base:1, md:2, lg:3}}; on a narrow viewport all controls in DashboardFilterBar (project picker, date preset, severity) must remain reachable, not clipped or overlapped by the card grid.
steps: Resize the browser (or use a mobile device emulation) to a 375px-wide viewport
Open the Filters project picker and select a different project
expectedResult: Cards stack in a single column, the filter bar's controls are fully visible and operable, and the project selection still triggers a metrics refresh.
